description: babb / derres / derext (derivatives) and angle / lmaxxx / kclbsch / clbsch / setleg (angular). Unreachable from RECONR (it hardcodes both flags off); build alongside ERRORR, their real caller. Per the no-orphaned-dead-code rule.
title: SAMM derivatives + angular distributions (deferred to ERRORR)

description: Beyond dup/split: MPI_Comm_group, MPI_Group_incl/excl/union/intersection, MPI_Group_translate_ranks, and MPI_Cart_create/coords/shift. Build on the local->global rank map already in Communicator. Split from op-wor.
title: mpi: groups (MPI_Group_incl/excl, rank translation) + Cartesian topologies

description: Local/global ARAP deformation (Sorkine-Alexa 2007) on the cotangent-Laplacian foundation: per-vertex optimal rotation fit (3x3 closest-rotation) local step + boundary-pinned cotangent-Laplacian global solve (faer sparse Cholesky, factor once). Handle vertices are constraints. The crate's second sparse-solve operator.
title: outram-blender: ARAP (as-rigid-as-possible) surface deformation

description: Compact v2 UI: main page (key temperatures, flowrates, heater power, sim time), controls page (heater, pump, set points, frequency response, branch blocking), OPC-UA page displaying the endpoint URL and the full node table so a user knows how to connect, plus plots. Non-Android only (egui/eframe are Android-hostile).
title: ciet_v2: egui UI (main + controls + OPC-UA connection page)

description: ReactorVesselVisual (crates/outram-park-digital-twin-gui/src/components/reactor_vessel.rs) gains a physics: nee_soon::NordheimFuchsExactTimestepper field, mirroring PipeVisual's physics: tampines::components::Pipe pattern. Rendering stays minimal-static (fixed neutral-colour outline) -- deriving colour/fill from physics.power is left to a future pass, same as PipeVisual's placeholder hotness=0.5. InstrumentationVisual stays a generic label/value placeholder since nee_soon does not expose a dedicated instrumentation-readout type. Scope explicitly confirmed with the user 2026-07-14: adding the physics field/type-wiring is in scope even though GUI layout/design work is otherwise on hold (see feedback-gui-is-manual-work memory) -- visual/rendering design itself was not touched.
title: Wire nee_soon's Nordheim-Fuchs type into ReactorVesselVisual
